title: ScadPub configuration
description: scadpub.config.json. Generated from scripts/lib/config-spec.mjs by scripts/gen-config-schema.mjs — see docs/config.md for the full human reference.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to a JSON Schema for editor tooling; not read by gen-schema itself.

title.description: Browser tab title and header text.

id.description: Namespaces localStorage, IndexedDB and the preset cache (charset [A-Za-z0-9._-]+).

description.default: Configure and export designs in your browser.

pwa.description: Manifest-only PWA chrome (install metadata, icons, theming) that feeds manifest.webmanifest and the icon rasterizer at build time. Not mirrored into designs.json — the app itself never reads a 'pwa' object.

icon.description: PWA/favicon icon path, relative to the config file.

iconMaskable.description: Separate SVG for the maskable icon; defaults to 'icon'.

themeColor.description: Per-theme PWA/browser-chrome colour: a string for both themes, or { light, dark } (either may be omitted, defaulting independently: light '#ffffff', dark '#1f2229'). Same shape as 'logo'.

backgroundColor.description: PWA manifest background colour. A CSS colour string (hex, rgb()/rgba()/hsl()/hsla(), or a named colour).

screenshots.description: Richer Android install-UI screenshots: [{ src, sizes, form_factor, label?, platform? }].

shortcuts.description: App shortcuts for Android long-press / desktop jump lists: [{ name, short_name?, url, icons? }].

install.description: PWA install affordance; 'off' hides it entirely.

source.description: Directory of Customizer-style .scad designs, relative to the config file.

designs.description: Explicit design list; omit to auto-discover *.scad in 'source'.

id.description: Design id (charset [A-Za-z0-9._-]+); used in URLs, storage, filenames.

label.description: Picker label; defaults to a humanized id.

file.description: Path to the .scad file, relative to 'source'; defaults to '<id>.scad'.

heavy.description: Start this design in manual-render mode.

group.description: Dropdown/gallery grouping header; consecutive same-value designs cluster.

images.description: Bundled-preset thumbnails: either a preset-name -> image-path map (every key must match a real bundled preset name), or a single config-relative directory string (each preset's image looked up by slugifying its name — see docs/config.md). Preset images are optional per preset either way.

defaultDesign.description: Design id shown on a visit with no #d= deep link; must name a configured design.

assets.description: Files/directories/globs to bundle verbatim; omit to follow use/include.

render.description: Rendering: OpenSCAD flags/format/fonts (render inputs — folded into renderHash) plus build-time heavy-render-threshold/cache tuning ('heavyMs'/'cache' — display/perf only, absent from renderHash).

features.description: OpenSCAD --enable=<feature> flags applied to every render. Folded into renderHash.

format.description: Export/preview model format. Folded into renderHash.

fonts.description: Bundled font files (public/fonts basenames or 'source'-relative paths). Folded into renderHash.

fontFallback.description: A bundled family pinned as fontconfig's last-resort default. Folded into renderHash.

heavyMs.description: Auto-pause threshold (ms) for a slow live render. NOT in renderHash.

cache.description: Sizes the runner's two-tier render cache.

logo.description: Header logo: a path, or { light, dark } per-theme paths (config-relative).

light.description: Logo path used in the light theme.

dark.description: Logo path used in the dark theme.

extraCss.description: Raw-CSS stylesheet path (config-relative), loaded after the app's own styles.

ui.description: Build-time UI behaviour: panel/output defaults and labels.

panelSide.description: Which edge the desktop parameter panel docks against.

outputDefault.description: Whether the OpenSCAD output console starts open.

showVarName.description: Show the OpenSCAD variable name beside each parameter label.

gallery.description: Replace the compact design dropdown with a searchable card grid.

essentials.description: Start with // @advanced parameters hidden behind 'Show all settings'.

afterExport.description: Turns on the after-export success panel: true for defaults, or { helpTab }.

helpTab.description: Opens Help scrolled to the tab with this label; must name a real help.tabs[].label.

viewer.description: The 3D viewer's presentation, framing, and per-control visibility, fixed at build time.

style.description: 'plain' is the classic CAD preview; 'studio' adds image-based lighting and a contact shadow.

restOnGrid.description: Rest the model's base on the z=0 grid instead of centring in Z (display-only).

grid.description: Seeds the viewer's reference-grid toggle's first-ever value. The toggle itself is always offered — this is not a visibility flag, unlike 'controls' below — and a visitor's own later choice persists and wins on every subsequent visit.

controls.description: Visibility of the individual viewer HUD control buttons. None of these hide the 3D canvas itself.

fullscreen.description: Show the fullscreen toggle (browser tabs only).

fileImport.description: Enables the Files dialog. true for defaults, or an options object; omit/false/null for no Files action.

note.description: Markdown-subset guidance shown atop the Files dialog. Mutually exclusive with 'noteFile'.

noteFile.description: Config-relative Markdown file whose contents become 'note' at build time. Mutually exclusive with 'note' (setting both fails the build, naming both).

popup.description: One-off notice dialog shown over the app on load.

body.description: Dialog message (Markdown subset). Mutually exclusive with 'bodyFile'.

bodyFile.description: Config-relative Markdown file whose contents become 'body' at build time. Mutually exclusive with 'body' (setting both fails the build, naming both).

footnote.description: Short plain-text line shown small and muted at the bottom.

help.description: Help dialog content: 'sections' for a single pane, or 'tabs' for a tabbed guide. A pane (the top-level object, or any 'tabs[]' entry) may set 'file' instead of 'sections' — a config-relative Markdown file gen-schema splits into 'intro'/'sections' at build time (see docs/config.md). Passed through verbatim otherwise, with any 'file' already resolved.

notices.description: Design-defined notice categories surfaced on the OpenSCAD output panel.

marker.description: Design-defined word matched as ': <marker>:' inside an echo (case-insensitive).

label.description: Badge/notice noun: a plain string used for both counts, or { one, other } for distinct singular/plural forms (selected via Intl.PluralRules, the same as src/lib/i18n.ts's tn()). Defaults to 'marker'.

color.description: Badge fill colour, a plain CSS colour.

attention.description: Join the pre-download review dialog's attention items.

subsumedByFont.description: Fold into a missing-font item instead of listing separately.

licenses.description: Extra third-party software/license notices, appended to the built-in attributions.

text.description: Full license text, shown in a details panel. Mutually exclusive with 'textFile'.

textFile.description: Config-relative file whose contents become 'text' at build time. Mutually exclusive with 'text' (setting both fails the build, naming both).

strings.description: Per-deployment overrides of src/locales/en.json, keyed by the same catalogue keys.
